info.description: Multi-tenant school, family, learning and tutoring platform API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable `code`.
info.title: School API

post.summary: Sign in a student with the QR token or text code their teacher printed (case and hyphen are ignored); every failure is the same 400 auth.invalid_code
Sign out this device: revokes the refresh token's session
Sign out everywhere: revokes every session of the signed-in user
Send a one-time sign-in code to a phone (SMS) or email; the answer is the same whether or not an account exists
Exchange a one-time code for tokens
Sign in with email, phone or username and a password
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair; the old refresh token stops working

Accept a live invitation with the one-time code: finds or creates the adult's account, links them to the child (PENDING until the school verifies, unless the school auto-verifies its own SMS/email invites accepted from the invited destination) and signs them in. Wrong or expired codes are 400 auth.invalid_code

Send a one-time code to the phone or email of the adult accepting a live invitation (even when no account exists; 3 per destination and 20 per address per hour). 404 invitation.not_found for unknown, expired, revoked or used-up invitations

What a live invitation is about, before signing in: school, the child's first name, relationship, channel. Unknown, expired, revoked and used-up invitations are all 404 invitation.not_found; guessing is rate limited (429)

get.summary: The signed-in user, their roles and permissions per scope

patch.summary: Change display name, preferred language, timezone or calendar; absent fields stay unchanged

delete.summary: Remove my avatar and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY AVATAR upload of mine as my avatar (the previous file is deleted)

get.summary: My children through ACTIVE links that are not custody-restricted (record, schools, classes and teachers when the link allows academics); PENDING requests listed apart with the child's first name only
The caller's classes as student or teacher across schools, with school and the caller's role (at most 200, active only unless includeArchived)

For each child I may give consent for (ACTIVE link, not restricted, can_give_consent) and school: ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION and MEDIA_PUBLICATION with the current text, my latest decision and whether a new decision is needed; plus my own TERMS and PRIVACY

post.summary: Record a decision on the current policy version: for a child (studentId; schoolId when the child is in several schools) ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION or MEDIA_PUBLICATION, or for myself (no studentId) TERMS or PRIVACY. 404 consent.child_not_found for children I may not decide for, 409 consent.version_outdated for any version but the current one

Redeem an invitation link token or printed parent code as the signed-in adult (STANDARD account with a verified phone or email, which is the proof). Creates a PENDING link (or returns the existing one); unknown, expired or used-up invitations are 404 invitation.not_found

get.summary: Every notification type by category with its channels: enabled (stored choice, else the type's default) and locked (the user cannot change it)

put.summary: Switch PUSH on or off per type; locked types and IN_APP cannot be switched off (400 notification.preference_locked)

get.summary: Quiet hours (in my timezone) and digest mode

put.summary: Set quiet hours (both times or neither); only digest mode OFF exists so far
Set or change the password; other sessions are signed out. A first password needs a recent sign-in

post.summary: Register (or refresh) this device's push token for my current session; a token already registered to someone else moves to me

delete.summary: Stop pushes to one of my devices (idempotent)

get.summary: The purposes that accept uploads, with allowed types and size limits

post.summary: Start an upload: validates purpose, type and size, and returns a presigned PUT URL (10 minutes)

delete.summary: Delete a media file (uploader or manager of its context)

get.summary: Status and metadata of a media file

post.summary: Verify the uploaded object (size, type, magic bytes) and queue processing

get.summary: A signed GET link (5 minutes) for a variant; images need THUMB, SMALL or MEDIUM
Service metadata and server time
My notifications, newest first (archived ones excluded)

post.summary: Mark every unread notification read
Send myself a test notification (platform administrators): inbox, real-time and push

get.summary: How many unread notifications I have

post.summary: Remove a notification from the inbox (idempotent)
Mark one notification read (idempotent)

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first; filter by action prefix, actor, target, school and time range
Every feature and setting definition (key, schema, default, allowed scopes), for override editors

delete.summary: Remove a feature override so the next level applies

get.summary: Feature overrides at exactly one scope

put.summary: Enable or disable a feature at a scope

get.summary: List organizations the caller may manage, newest first

post.summary: Create an organization in an enabled country

get.summary: Get an organization

put.summary: Update name, legal name and status (the slug is fixed)

delete.summary: Remove the organization's logo and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this organization as its logo (the previous file is deleted)

get.summary: The plans a school can be given, with localized names
Role assignments of a user, or at exactly one scope; only those the caller may manage

post.summary: Grant a role to a user at a scope (at or below the caller's own scope, never more than the caller holds)

delete.summary: Revoke a role assignment (it stays listed as REVOKED)

get.summary: List the schools the caller can see, newest first, filtered by country, organization, status

post.summary: Create a school (ONBOARDING) in an enabled country; unset fields inherit the country's defaults

get.summary: Get a school
List a school's campuses

post.summary: Add a campus to a school

get.summary: A school's effective features and settings, with the level each value comes from

delete.summary: Remove the school's cover image and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this school as its cover image

delete.summary: Remove the school's logo and delete its file

put.summary: Use a READY BRANDING upload made for this school as its logo (the previous file is deleted)
Manually assign a plan to a school, ending its current subscription

delete.summary: Remove a setting override so the next level applies

get.summary: Setting overrides at exactly one scope, optionally one key

put.summary: Set a setting at a scope; the value is validated against the definition's schema

post.summary: Create an ACTIVE user whose phone or email is marked verified (the administrator vouches for it)

get.summary: Find a user by an exact phone or email (no listing or search); 404 when there is none
A user's display name and masked destination, by id

The current text of a policy (public): the school's own document if it has a published version, else the country default (country, default ET); in lang, else English, else any language. 404 policy.not_found

post.summary: A single-use ticket (60 seconds) to open the WebSocket at /ws from a browser, sent as the STOMP CONNECT header 'ticket'

get.summary: Enabled countries with languages, calendars, currency, address and name formats
Administrative areas of a country (region, zone, woreda ...), by level and parent
Enabled languages
A school's id, name and status from its slug; 404 when unknown or when the caller cannot read it
The school's academic years, newest first (a short list, no paging)

post.summary: Create an academic year (PLANNED unless stated); makeCurrent also makes it the school's current year

delete.summary: Delete a year with its periods; 409 when it is current or classes use it

get.summary: One academic year

patch.summary: Change name, dates or status (absent fields stay); 409 when the new dates cut off a period or the current year would be closed

post.summary: Make this the school's only current year (the previous current year stays as it is; a CLOSED year cannot be current)

get.summary: The year's periods in sequence order

post.summary: Add a period: within the year, no overlap with other periods (409 academic.period_overlap), unique sequence (defaults to the next)

delete.summary: Delete a period

patch.summary: Change a period (same rules as creating one)

get.summary: Classes the caller may see (students and teachers: their own; administrators: all in scope), by name; filters year, grade, campus, status, type, mine, q

post.summary: Create a class: needs class.manage, or be a teacher of the school while classes.teachers_can_create is on (the teacher becomes lead)

delete.summary: Delete a class that never had students (and no teacher besides its first lead); otherwise 409 class.not_empty, archive it instead

get.summary: One class the caller may see; 404 otherwise

patch.summary: Change a class (lead teacher or class.manage; campus and year only with class.manage); subjectIds replaces the set

post.summary: Archive a class: it stays readable and keeps its members, but its roster can no longer change

get.summary: The roster's consent column (teachers of the class, class managers, school.guardians.manage): per ACTIVE student the effective ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION and MEDIA_PUBLICATION status, without guardian identities. Treat MEDIA_PUBLICATION UNKNOWN as not allowed
Saved student groups of the class (teachers of the class)

post.summary: Save a group of the class's students (a result of the group maker)

delete.summary: Delete a saved group

post.summary: Issue new login codes for students of the class (default: all ACTIVE students); their previous live codes are revoked. The plaintext codes are in this response only, with Cache-Control: no-store

delete.summary: Revoke one login code of the class's sheet

post.summary: Print parent codes (home connection) for students of the class (default: all ACTIVE students): one code per student for up to guardians.parent_code.max_uses adults within guardians.parent_code.ttl_days; the student's previous live code is revoked. Links made with a code are always PENDING. The codes are in this response only (Cache-Control: no-store); do not send an Idempotency-Key
Make an archived class active again

get.summary: The class's ACTIVE students by name (at most 500, no paging). Date of birth, gender and username only for teachers of the class and school.students.manage (accessLevel FULL); everybody else gets name and avatar

post.summary: Add students of the school to the class (all or none; 409 when one is not enrolled or already a member)

delete.summary: End a student's membership (history is kept); reason REMOVED (default) or PROMOTED

post.summary: Move a student to another class of the school: ends this membership (TRANSFERRED_CLASS) and starts the new one, atomically

get.summary: The class's ACTIVE teachers: lead first

post.summary: Add a teacher of the school (lead teacher or class.manage); SUBJECT_TEACHER needs subjectId

delete.summary: Remove a teacher row (lead or class.manage; any non-lead teacher may remove herself); the last lead cannot be removed (409 class.last_lead)

get.summary: The school's grade levels in sequence order

post.summary: Add a grade level (sequence defaults to the next; unique per school)

delete.summary: Delete a grade level; 409 when classes use it (deactivate it instead)

patch.summary: Change a grade level, or deactivate it

post.summary: Revoke an invitation or a printed parent code; links already made stay as they are

get.summary: The verification queue: links of the school's ACTIVE students in one status (default PENDING), oldest first. Administrators see all, verifying lead teachers the students of their classes

patch.summary: Change a PENDING or ACTIVE link: permission flags, relationship, primary guardian (one per child), custody restriction with an admin-only note (a restricted link grants nothing)

post.summary: Verify a PENDING link (SCHOOL_VERIFIED): it becomes ACTIVE and the guardian is notified. 409 guardian_link.not_pending otherwise
Reject a PENDING link; the adult is notified
End a link: access stops with the guardian's next request

get.summary: Import history, newest first; filters status and importType

post.summary: Start an import from an uploaded file (media purpose IMPORT_FILE, READY): reads the header and the first rows, detects encoding and delimiter, suggests the column mapping

get.summary: Saved column mappings, optionally of one import type

post.summary: Save a column mapping (field key to header text) for an import type; 409 import.profile_name_taken

delete.summary: Delete a profile (imports that used it keep their mapping)

put.summary: Rename a profile or replace its mapping

get.summary: A template for the import type: header row of machine keys, an example row starting with # (ignored), instructions in English and Amharic (xlsx also has lists of the school's classes, grade levels and campuses)
The kinds of file that can be imported, with their columns (labels in the reader's language) and required fields

delete.summary: Delete an import with its rows and uploaded file at once (409 while it runs)

get.summary: One import: status, progress (poll while VALIDATING or COMMITTING), row counts, commit result, failure

post.summary: Cancel an import that was not committed yet; its rows are purged at once

Apply a VALIDATED import in the background: needs no unresolved duplicates, an unchanged file and mapping since the dry run, and no invalid rows unless skipInvalidRows. Poll until COMPLETED. After a FAILED commit the same call resumes
Check every row in the background (nothing is written to the school); poll the import until VALIDATED or FAILED. Allowed again after a change of mapping or a failure

get.summary: CSV of every problem: the file's columns plus row_number, severity, field, message (UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, formula-safe cells). Not cached

put.summary: Save the column mapping (field key to column index) and reading options; the file is read again with them and the job is PREVIEWED. 400 import.mapping_incomplete lists what is missing. Optionally saves the mapping as a profile

get.summary: The preview again (headers, first rows, mapping so far), for reloading the mapping step. When any of encoding, delimiter or sheet is given (an empty value means detect), the file is read that way instead and the mapping is suggested from the new headers; nothing is saved until the mapping is
The checked rows in file order (keyset by row number); filter status VALID, INVALID, DUPLICATE or SKIPPED. Errors and warnings are in the reader's language

post.summary: Decide a possible duplicate: LINK to an existing student (studentId), CREATE_NEW or SKIP. SKIP is also allowed for any row that was not applied yet

get.summary: The school's own policy documents with every version (drafts included)

post.summary: Start the school's own wording of ACCOUNT_PARTICIPATION or MEDIA_PUBLICATION (409 policy.already_exists); it replaces the country default once a version is published
Add a draft version in one language (one row per label and language; 409 policy.version_exists)

put.summary: Change a draft version (409 policy.version_published once published)

post.summary: Publish a draft: it becomes immutable and takes effect at effectiveFrom (now at the earliest). With requiresReconsent, guardians are asked again and earlier grants stop counting once it is in effect

get.summary: Staff by name; filters staffType, status, campusId, q. Managers see every status and masked contacts, other staff only ACTIVE colleagues

post.summary: Add a person to the school's staff by phone or email: finds their account or creates one the administrator vouches for; 409 staff.already_member when they are staff already

get.summary: One staff member

patch.summary: Change job title, campus or employee number (absent fields stay)

post.summary: Mark the staff member FORMER (ended today) and end their class teaching; administrative roles are not touched

get.summary: Students by name (ACTIVE unless status is given); filters classId, gradeLevelId, campusId, status, q. School.students.manage sees all, teachers the students of their classes

post.summary: Create a school-managed student (no phone or email) and enroll them; optionally straight into a class. Needs school.students.manage, or be a teacher of that class

get.summary: One student: FULL for managers, the student and their teachers; BASIC (name, avatar) for classmates and class administrators; 404 for everybody else

patch.summary: Change a student's details (school.students.manage); the student themself may change only avatarConfig

get.summary: The child's effective statuses and every consent record, newest first (school.guardians.manage)

post.summary: Record a decision the school received on paper or verbally (school.guardians.manage): from a guardian link that may give consent (409 consent.guardian_not_eligible otherwise) or from a named guardian without an account

get.summary: The student's guardian invitations, newest first (destinations masked; never tokens or codes)

post.summary: Invite an adult by SMS or email to link to the student (single use, 14 days, sent in the school's language). The phone or email is not proof of guardianship: accepting creates a PENDING link. At most 10 live invitations per student (409 invitation.limit_reached)

get.summary: The student's guardian links. Administrators (school.guardians.manage) see every status with masked contact details and notes; teachers of the student see PENDING and ACTIVE links with names, relationship and status only

post.summary: Link an adult the school knows (the administrator vouches): found by phone or email or created, the link is ACTIVE (SCHOOL_VERIFIED)

get.summary: Metadata of the student's live login codes (never the codes); managers and teachers of the student

post.summary: Revoke every live login code of the student
Set an initial password (the student must change it); only while the school allows password sign-in (409 student.password_login_disabled) and the student has a username
Withdraw a student from the school: class memberships end, login codes are revoked, history stays

get.summary: The school's subjects by name

post.summary: Add a subject (code unique per school, case-insensitive)

delete.summary: Delete a subject; 409 when classes use it (deactivate it instead)

patch.summary: Change a subject, or deactivate it

get.summary: Counts of active students, teachers and classes plus what is already set up (current year, grade levels, subjects); needs school.read

current.description: Exactly one year of a school is current

AddStaffRequest.description: Set exactly one of phone or email (national phone formats are read in `country`, default ET). adminRole is only for ADMINISTRATOR.

classes.description: Empty unless the link allows viewing academics

id.description: Roster row id, used to remove the teacher

myMembership.description: How the caller belongs to this class; absent for administrators who only manage it

myTeacherRole.description: The caller's teacher role when myMembership is TEACHER

skipInvalidRows.description: Apply the valid rows and leave the invalid ones out

CommitResult.description: What the commit did; present from COMMITTING on

guardianContacts.description: Parent contacts of the file saved for a later invitation (no guardian link is made); absent in history lists

currentVersion.description: The text to decide on; absent when no policy is published

myDecision.description: My latest decision (for a child: the latest decision of my link, also when the school recorded it)

needsDecision.description: No decision yet, or an outdated one

outdated.description: My GRANTED decision is on a version superseded by one that requires new consent

decidedByName.description: The guardian (account name or the name written on paper)

recordedBy.description: Staff member who recorded a paper or verbal decision

reason.description: GRANTED: at least one current guardian granted and nobody refused; DENIED / WITHDRAWN: a current guardian (or a paper record) refused or withdrew; RECONSENT_REQUIRED: the only grants are on a version superseded by one that requires new consent; NO_DECISION: nobody decided yet

addressFormat.description: Labels per administrative level and language, required levels, postal rules

nameFormat.description: Labels for given_name / middle_name / family_name per language

CreateGuardianRequest.description: Exactly one of phone or email. National phone formats are read in `country` (default: the school's country).

mappingProfileId.description: A saved mapping profile to apply; otherwise the newest matching profile or the header synonyms are used

mediaId.description: A READY media of purpose IMPORT_FILE in this school

columnMapping.description: Field key to the header text of the column in the school's files

avatarConfig.description: Avatar builder configuration, a JSON object owned by the clients

username.description: Lower case, starts with a letter, 3-31 of a-z 0-9 . _ - ; unique across the platform

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page
Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page

Failure.description: Why a job is FAILED: the phase (VALIDATE or COMMIT), the first failing row if any, and a localized message

enabled.description: Flag enabled AND entitled by the plan

limit.description: The plan's numeric limit; absent = unlimited

oneOf.description: At least one field of the same group must be mapped

contactMatchesInvitation.description: SMS/email invitations: whether the adult proved the invited phone or email; school.guardians.manage only

custodyRestricted.description: Grants nothing at all while true (court order etc.)

invitedName.description: The name the inviter typed; school.guardians.manage only

columnMapping.description: Field key to zero-based column index

rowsPurged.description: True once the raw rows and the uploaded file were purged (retention)

skipInvalidRows.description: Commit only: apply the valid rows and skip the invalid ones

ImportPreview.description: The first lines of the file with what was detected and the suggested column mapping

missingFields.description: Required fields still missing from the mapping

requiredFields.description: What must be mapped: required fields, and 'a|b' where one of a, b is enough

suggestedMapping.description: The job's current mapping: the suggestion until the user saves one

applyResult.description: CREATED, UPDATED, UNCHANGED or SKIPPED after the commit

cells.description: Original cells in column order; absent after the purge

duplicateCandidates.description: Existing students that may be the same person (possible duplicates)

normalized.description: What the commit applies, as understood from the cells; absent after the purge

resolution.description: LINK, CREATE_NEW or SKIP once a possible duplicate was decided

InvitationAcceptRequest.description: Set exactly one of token or code, and the same phone or email the code was sent to.

displayName.description: Name for a new account (ignored for an existing one)

preferredLanguage.description: Language for a new account, e.g. am or en

InvitationKeyRequest.description: Exactly one of token (from the invitation link) or code (printed parent code, any case, hyphen optional).

InvitationOtpRequest.description: Set exactly one of token (from the invitation link) or code (printed parent code), and exactly one of phone or email.

destination.description: Masked phone or email (SMS and EMAIL invitations)

status.description: EXPIRED when the validity ended while still unused

InviteGuardianRequest.description: Exactly one of phone or email. National phone formats are read in `country` (default: the school's country).

guardianName.description: A hint for verifiers, not proof

ttlDays.description: Days the codes stay valid (1-730); default setting students.login_code.ttl_days

code.description: A QR token or a text code such as K7M2P-9XQ4T

avatar.description: READY avatar; ask /media/{id}/url for a signed link

memberships.description: ACTIVE school memberships as teacher, student or other staff (not administrative roles, which are in roleAssignments); clients build navigation and the mobile role from them

scopes.description: Permissions merged per scope, from all roles held there

pending.description: Link requests waiting for the school's verification

role.description: The caller's role in this class

teacherRole.description: Teacher role when role is TEACHER

account.description: The adult's own TERMS and PRIVACY

data.description: Routing data; 'path' is a relative in-app path

OtpRequest.description: Set exactly one of phone or email. National phone formats are read in `country` (default ET).

example.description: A row starting with # is an example or comment: it is ignored

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 9457 problem details returned by every failing endpoint.

columnMapping.description: Field key to the header text of the column

maxBytesByMimeType.description: Allowed MIME types with their maximum size in bytes

value.description: Any JSON value valid for the setting

effectiveStatus.description: The child's effective status after this decision (children only)

RedeemRequest.description: Exactly one of token or code. relationshipType is used when the invitation names none (printed codes).

resolution.description: How a possible duplicate is decided: LINK to an existing student (studentId), CREATE_NEW, or SKIP the row

studentId.description: The existing student to link to (LINK only)

schoolName.description: Name of the school (SCHOOL and CAMPUS scopes)

schoolSlug.description: Slug of the school (SCHOOL and CAMPUS scopes), for /s/{slug} URLs

scopeName.description: Display name of the scope; absent for PLATFORM

RoleScope.description: A role scope. PLATFORM sets no key, COUNTRY sets countryCode, ORGANIZATION sets organizationId, SCHOOL sets schoolId, CAMPUS sets campusId (and optionally its schoolId).

RowCounts.description: Counts of the checked rows; present from VALIDATED on. The last four are absent in history lists and after the purge

duplicates.description: Possible duplicates still waiting for a decision

unchanged.description: Valid rows that would change nothing

columnMapping.description: Field key to zero-based column index

saveAsProfile.description: Also save this mapping as a profile with this name

planIsFreeFallback.description: True when the school has no live subscription and gets SCHOOL_FREE

versions.description: Drafts and published versions, newest first

ScopeRef.description: A configuration scope. PLATFORM sets no key, COUNTRY sets countryCode, ORGANIZATION sets organizationId, SCHOOL sets schoolId.

valueSchema.description: JSON Schema subset the value must satisfy

timezone.description: The timezone quiet hours are evaluated in

StaffConsentRequest.description: Exactly one of guardianLinkId or guardianName. Evidence uploads (scanned forms) are not supported yet.

userId.description: The person's user id (a teacher's id in class rosters)

id.description: The student's user id; used in every path and roster

accessTokenExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

refreshTokenExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the refresh token expires if unused

restrictionNote.description: Visible to school.guardians.manage only; never audited

quietHoursStart.description: HH:mm in my timezone, or absent for no quiet hours

context.description: What the media belongs to; optional for AVATAR (the caller)

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the file; verified during processing

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the file in bytes

UserScope.description: A level of the tenancy hierarchy; exactly the key of its type is set (a campus also has its school).

bearer.description: Access token from /api/v1/auth/* (15 minutes; renew with /api/v1/auth/refresh)
